water_retention.tear_off_rationale: Roof is 26 years old, exceeding the typical service life (20-25 years) for standard asphalt shingles. A full tear-off is essential to assess the condition of the underlying decking, inspect for hidden rot or damage, replace the old underlayment, and ensure a proper, long-lasting installation of new roofing components. Risk of hidden water ingress increases significantly with age.

shingle_recommendation.rationale: Given the roof's age (26 years) and the inferred condition of advanced wear and granule loss, a full tear-off is the only recommended action. This ensures a clean substrate, allows for decking inspection and repair, and permits the installation of a complete new roofing system with modern underlayment and ventilation improvements.
